items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The old lady was burned up. [INTERVIEWEE] Well she couldn't move, she was an infant like this...

ctx.x: The old lady was burned up.
Well she couldn't move, she was an infant like this, that's how she went to. And he must have went home full of liquor or something, I mean he went in bed, I mean that's how he caught a fire.
